grid-align.xlsx.tests: XLS-01/XLS-02 header/cell edge alignment at multiple scroll offsets, unequal widths, column resize

merges.xlsx.tests: XLS-03 merged rectangle rendering (single anchor cell spanning the range)

narrow-fit.docx.tests: DOC-01 readiness at exactly 100% fit; DOC-02 manual zoom controls

multipage.docx.tests: docs/15 #4 DOCX zoom reachable at 320px: zoom in/out/fit-width, pannable zoomed content, last page reachable

styled.xlsx.tests: Cell styling from the workbook's own style table: bold/italic/underline/strike, font colours, solid fills (rgb and tinted theme colours), alignment, filled cells with no value, an unstyled second sheet. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

charts.pptx.tests: Slide charts drawn from cached values: clustered columns with title and legend, stacked sideways bars, lines with markers, pie, scatter; a radar chart must fall back to the labelled placeholder. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

rtl.pptx.tests: Right-to-left text in slides: an Urdu title with no direction flag (detected from the text), a flagged Urdu bullet, an English line that stays left-to-right, an Arabic line. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

grid.xlsx.tests: The spreadsheet grid: panes frozen at C2 (one header row, two columns), a bordered cell, text that runs over empty neighbours and text that is stopped by one, a bar chart and a picture on the sheet, a second sheet for find-across-sheets. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

cjk.pdf.tests: A Chinese page set in a font the file names but does not embed (STSong-Light): readable only with pdf.js's character maps, which ship with the app. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

wide-fit.pdf.tests: PDF-02 fit -> manual conversion preserves a fit scale far below 0.5

effects.pptx.tests: Slide effects: an outer shadow on a shape and on a picture, linear gradients on a triangle and a freeform, a radial gradient on an ellipse, and a SmartArt diagram stored as PowerPoint stores one (a data model naming the drawing part with its laid-out shapes; hand-built, not saved by PowerPoint). Three slides, for full-screen mode. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

locked.pdf.tests: A two-page PDF that needs the password "wren": the password dialog, a wrong password, and the retry that reuses the same load. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

locked-agile.xlsx.tests: sample.xlsx protected with the password "wren" the Office 2010+ way (agile encryption: AES-256-CBC, SHA-512, 100,000 rounds), written by msoffcrypto-tool. Salts are random, so the bytes differ on every regeneration. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py

locked-standard.docx.tests: sample.docx protected with the password "wren" the Office 2007 way (standard encryption: AES-128-ECB, SHA-1, 50,000 rounds). Assembled by the generator from the specification and read back with msoffcrypto-tool as a check; not saved by Office. Regenerate with scripts/make-rich-fixtures.py
